title: practical but a taste of soap
text: practical but a taste of soap. They are pretty practical and sturdy. Kindda easy to clean (i place mine in the dishwasher 3-4 at a time) and they cook envenly. However, anything i make in them tastes like soap. I cleaned them once with perfumed laundry detergent and it stick to them and even having these for over a year and only using perfumed soap once they still leave soap taste to the food. Dont recommend.
